articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. The model demonstrates substantial improvements on agentic coding benchmarks such as SWE-Bench Verified, scoring above 75%, and introduces a new low-latency streaming mode aimed at real-time developer copilot use cases.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Model Enables Zero-Shot Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: DeepMind published results showing its Gemini-powered robotics foundation model can perform complex object manipulation tasks in cluttered, previously unseen environments without task-specific fine-tuning. The system uses a vision-language-action architecture that maps natural language instructions and RGB-D input directly to motor torques, achieving an 85% success rate on novel household tasks in real-world trials.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Extended Thinking with Verified Chain-of-Thought for Safety-Critical Applications
articles.summary: Anthropic announced an update to its Claude model family that adds formally verified chain-of-thought reasoning steps, designed for deployment in safety-critical domains such as medical diagnostics and infrastructure monitoring. The system uses a secondary verifier model that checks logical consistency of each reasoning step before the final output is emitted, reducing hallucination rates by over 60% on clinical benchmarking suites.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in select Gigafactory assembly lines for material handling and quality inspection tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous hands with 22 degrees of freedom and on-device vision transformers that allow sub-second part recognition, though Tesla emphasizes they still operate alongside human workers in a collaborative capacity.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 with 400B MoE Architecture and Native Tool-Use Grounding
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 under a permissive license, featuring a 400-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts architecture that activates roughly 52B parameters per forward pass. The model ships with built-in tool-use grounding that allows it to reliably generate structured API calls, SQL queries, and code execution requests, positioning it as a strong open-weight competitor for enterprise agentic workflows.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced the start of volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, with initial allocation going to AI accelerator chips. The new node delivers approximately 25% improved performance and 35% lower power consumption compared to N2, which is expected to be critical for next-generation data center GPUs and on-device AI inference processors.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment to Full Vehicle Sub-Assembly Workflow
articles.summary: Figure AI announced an expanded partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots across an entire vehicle sub-assembly workflow at BMW's Spartanburg plant, moving beyond the single-station pilot that began in 2025. The robots now handle multi-step sequences including part retrieval, insertion, and fastening, coordinated through a centralized task planner that dynamically re-allocates work based on real-time throughput data.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 1,000-Cycle Durability in EV-Format Cells
articles.summary: QuantumScape disclosed independently validated test results showing its multi-layer solid-state lithium-metal battery cells retained over 90% capacity after 1,000 full charge-discharge cycles at automotive-relevant conditions. The achievement addresses the key durability concern that has delayed solid-state commercialization and puts the company on track for its announced 2027 partnership vehicle launch with Volkswagen's PowerCo division.
